reporting_year: the grant year; the projects sheet is named for it
about: The regional subgranting ledger. The map uses grant streams per country and period, and partner countries (half dots). Columns and rules only; stream names and amounts stay in the organisation's storage.

rules.text: One row per grant. 'Funding source' maps to a legend stream through the stream crosswalk kept with the register, not in this repository. 'other countries' names partner countries: a partner country gets a half dot unless it already holds a full dot of the same stream.
Every column after the four fixed ones is a grant stream for one year; a mark in the cell means the country holds that stream. Stream columns are read, never listed here.
